name: Clicking a thumbnail switches the main image (Pixel 7a — seeded with 3 images)

preconditions.note: Pixel 7a variant c2b09ec4-... was seeded with 3 variant_images rows specifically for this test

steps.description: Jump straight to the known multi-image PDP (Pixel 7a Charcoal)
Thumbnails strip only renders when there are 2+ images
Capture main image src before thumbnail click

steps.script: (() => { const thumbs = document.querySelectorAll('.gallery-thumbs .gthumb'); const second = thumbs[1]; if (second) { second.click(); return { clicked: true, index: 1 }; } return { clicked: false }; })()

(() => { const main = document.querySelector('.gallery-main .main-img'); const activeThumb = document.querySelector('.gallery-thumbs .gthumb.on'); const activeIndex = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.gallery-thumbs .gthumb')).indexOf(activeThumb); return { src: main?.src || '', visible: main ? main.offsetWidth > 0 : false, activeIndex }; })()
steps.description: Second thumbnail is now the active one (has .on class)

businessContext: Thumbnail navigation lets customers inspect product details. This now asserts the active thumb actually changes via the .on class state, not just that the main image still renders.
